[RDSC.4.5.1] The runtime carries no decompressor, and must
reject any body whose `compression` is not `COMPRESSION_NONE`
with `DS_ERR_DSC_DECOMPRESS`. This is not a version
gate: an all-`COMPRESSION_NONE` artefact is readable by any
runtime, so artefacts stay forward-compatible and only the
runtime's codec support is narrow. A `.dsc` a runtime cannot
read is regenerated by recompiling its source — the `.dsc` is a
one-way compile-to-load substrate, not a durable format
([RARC.4]).
